title: SynerPlant Yield V4 - pre-registered POST-HOC re-use of the 2024-2026 TEST
honesty_statement: The TEST was already evaluated once (V2, 2026-11-18 11:03 UTC) and its V2 results (group-MAE 0.415, bias -0.32, single coverage 0.847) were known when the V4 idea was formed. V4 was selected on TRAIN cross-validation only, and no V4 code has read TEST values, but this evaluation is NOT an independent confirmation. Report it as a second look at a known TEST.

test_file.version: V3.1 TEST (same build rules as the V3.1 TRAIN)
test_file.read_before_registration: bytes hashed only; no value parsed

model_A_new.name: multilevel random-effects mean (rma.mv, study/contrast, REML, shared-control covariance)

intervals_90.construction: group-weighted CV+ / max-score CV+ on cross-fitted residuals (V2 s06 rule)

model_A_new.secondary_model_PI: half = 1.645*sqrt(sigma2_study + sigma2_contrast + vi_prior + se^2), vi_prior = cv2_pooled/n_t + cv2_pooled/n_c (n imputed with TRAIN medians); own SD not used

model_B_comparator.name: row median of V3.1 TRAIN (V2/V3.1 deployed rule)

metrics: coverage simultaneous (share of studies fully covered)
paired study bootstrap (4000) of A - B for group-MAE and interval score

criteria.H1_primary_interval: interval score single A < B AND coverage single A >= 0.85
criteria.H4_accuracy_noninferiority: group-MAE A <= 0.587 (V2 transport threshold) AND group-MAE A - B <= 0.05
criteria.verdict: SUPPORTED if H1 and H2 and H4; PARTIAL if H1 or H3 holds; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED. With 12 TEST studies the bootstrap CIs are reported, not used as pass criteria.

guards: refuse if any hashed file changed
refuse if TEST studies overlap TRAIN
the V2 TEST lock and V2 outputs are not modified
